email.body1:
Daniel, saw Placer.ai is expanding the platform with new data sets after roughly tripling revenue toward $100M+ ARR.

Growth that fast usually means more in-market accounts than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for your region off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.subject2: meetings to hit your region's number

Daniel, quick follow-up for your Placer.ai region.

At this growth rate, the target list usually outruns the team's capacity to work it. Most leaders don't know exactly how many meetings each rep needs to book to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your region needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
